OverlayMode.doc: What the full-screen overlay surface currently shows.

anchor.doc: In DIPs, relative to the client area of the surface that sent it (overlay.open) or of the overlay (overlay.show).

data.doc: appMenu: { appId } of the active app (items call dock.hide / dock.quit with itemId = appId).

token.doc: Increments on every show; stale async results can be dropped.
OverlayShow.token of the show being closed. The host ignores a close whose token is not the current one (stale animation finishing after a re-show).

overlay.show.doc: Published by the HOST (SurfaceManager) after it has shown/positioned the overlay window; never posted to a page that has not completed surface.ready.

overlay.hide.doc: Published by the HOST when IT hides the overlay (hotkey toggle, deactivation, monitor change).

overlay.open.doc: Any surface asks the host to open the overlay (e.g. menubar -> controlCenter popover). Anchor is translated to overlay coordinates.

overlay.close.doc: UI-initiated hide: the UI plays its exit animation, THEN calls overlay.close {token}. Host-initiated hides (hotkey toggle, deactivation, monitor change) post overlay.hide and raise ISurfaceManager.OverlayHidden.
